About your TV unit

Mr. Suresh · source model: sanganoor tv panel (3).skp. Original geometry measures 7 ft wide × 8 ft 8 in high × 12 in overall depth. All 48 extracted source faces are available in Reference colours.

Vertical W207-style warm-brown PVC louvers with black grooves; glossy cream marble-look TV backing; 65-inch TV; matte walnut wooden shutters and a grey-tinted glass shutter. All five lower shutters lift upward and are handleless, with open storage inside. The orange-marked strip uses warm-white concealed LED.

The four side compartments retain their supplied geometry. Panel thicknesses used for rendering, louver profiles, TV casing and marble veining are visual previews. Materials and pricing will appear after customer-specific confirmation. Finish choices save in this browser.
